headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders tie Seahawks 23-23 in Pete Carroll's Seattle return

Cleveland Browns at Carolina Panthers

headlines.shortLinkText: Browns' Shedeur Sanders impressive in NFL preseason debut, tosses 2 TD passes in win over Panthers

events.name: Washington Commanders at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — The first time TreVeyon Henderson touched the ball in an NFL game, he went nearly untouched by anyone else.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots offense shines in 48-18 exhibition win over Commanders, as Washington rests starters, vets

events.name: New York Giants at Buffalo Bills

headlines.shortLinkText: Russell Wilson and Jaxson Dart show promise in Giants' 34-25 preseason win at Bills

headlines.shortLinkText: J.J. McCarthy returns to help lead Vikings to 20-10 win over Texans in preseason opener

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — Brian Schottenheimer said he got emotional in the hours before his long-awaited first game as a head coach for the Dallas Cowboys.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stetson Bennett throws 2 TD passes, looks sharp in Rams' 31-21 preseason victory over Cowboys

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: — Travis Hunter’s professional debut included 10 snaps on offense, eight on defense and no highlights.
headlines.shortLinkText: Travis Hunter plays offense and defense in pro debut as Jaguars lose to Steelers in preseason

events.name: Tennessee Titans at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — Cam Ward's pro debut was solid, if unspectacular.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ward solid in NFL preseason debut, leading one scoring drive in Titans' 29-7 loss to Buccaneers

events.name: New York Jets at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — As soon as he recovered a fumble in the end zone to score a touchdown, New York Jets defensive tackle Jay Tufele went over to the sideline to give the ball to his new head coach.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fields scores in his lone series as Jets open 1st preseason under Glenn by beating Packers 30-10

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: — Quarterback Patrick Mahomes spent some time before Saturday's preseason game running up and down the Kansas City Chiefs sideline, yelling, jumping and psyching himself up for his first game action since last season's Super Bowl.
headlines.shortLinkText: One pass, one TD: Mahomes, Chiefs get off to good start in 20-17 preseason loss to Cardinals

events.name: Denver Broncos at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — Jarrett Stidham threw two TD passes following a lackluster performance from Bo Nix and Denver's starters, and the Broncos beat the San Francisco 49ers 30-9 in the preseason opener Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stidham shines after Nix struggles as Broncos beat 49ers 30-9 in preseason opener

events.name: Miami Dolphins at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: — Miami Dolphins quarterback Tua Tagovailoa saw the value in playing a series in Sunday's preseason opener even if it didn't end the way he would have liked.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dolphins, Bears finish in 24-24 tie in the preseason

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — Trey Lance scrambled for a 5-yard score and rookie Eric Rogers had a 43-yard pick-6 in a mostly sluggish offensive performance by the Los Angeles Chargers in a 27-13 exhibition win over the New Orleans Saints on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers' defense steps up in 27-13 preseason win against Saints

events.name: Tennessee Titans at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: — Kendell Brooks scored on a 53-yard interception return and rookie quarterback Cameron Ward had mixed results as the Tennessee Titans beat the Atlanta Falcons 23-20 in a preseason game Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brooks scores on interception return as Ward has mixed results in Titans' 23-20 win over Falcons

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — Sam Darnold looked the part of a franchise quarterback in his first appearance at Lumen Field as the Seattle Seahawks beat the Kansas City Chiefs 33-16 in a preseason game on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sam Darnold impresses in preseason debut with Seattle Seahawks, win against Kansas City Chiefs

events.name: Miami Dolphins at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — Backup quarterback Zach Wilson had a strong first half for the Dolphins and third-stringer Quinn Ewers threw for two second-half touchdowns as Miami beat the Detroit Lions 24-17 in the preseason on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zach Wilson and Quinn Ewers lead Dolphins to 24-17 preseason win over Lions

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — Indianapolis Colts quarterback Anthony Richardson again showed glimpses of his potential Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Richardson starts fast, Packers finish strong to rally past Colts 23-19 in preseason

events.name: New England Patriots at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: — New England rookies TreVeyon Henderson and Efton Chism III each had another preseason touchdown, and the Patriots beat the Minnesota Vikings 20-12 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots beat Vikings 20-12 as rookies Henderson and Chism each record another preseason TD

events.name: Cleveland Browns at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: — The Cleveland Browns had to turn to other quarterbacks with rookie Shedeur Sanders injured.
headlines.shortLinkText: K.J. Henry's pick-6 leads Browns to win over Eagles in preseason game with Shedeur Sanders sidelined

events.name: Carolina Panthers at Houston Texans

headlines.description: — C.J. Stroud found Nico Collins for a touchdown pass on his second drive Saturday in Houston's preseason win over the Carolina Panthers.
headlines.shortLinkText: C.J. Stroud's TD pass helps Texans defeat Panthers 20-3 in preseason

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — Raiders rookie Ashton Jeanty proved he could deliver hits and absorb them at the NFL level, rushing for a bruising 33 yards and a touchdown on seven carries in Las Vegas' 22-19 preseason loss to the San Francisco 49ers on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders rookie Ashton Jeanty takes a hit, then delivers one in 22-19 loss to the 49ers

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: — Cooper Rush threw a touchdown pass and a pick-6 in his return to AT&T Stadium, and rookie Tyler Loop kicked five field goals as the Baltimore Ravens beat the Dallas Cowboys 31-13 in a preseason game on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Happy homecomings for QB Cooper Rush, rookie K Tyler Loop in Ravens' 31-13 win over Cowboys

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — Another quarterback might have been a bit shaken after throwing a fourth-quarter interception to a 305-pound defensive tackle — and then getting run over by the big man while he rumbled downfield with the ball.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stetson Bennett rallies Rams to 23-22 preseason win over Chargers, overcoming D-line interception

events.name: New York Jets at New York Giants

headlines.description: — Getting snaps with the first-team offense, then throwing for a touchdown and running for another with the backups, Jaxson Dart shined in his new home stadium debut for the New York Giants as part of a 31-12 victory against the Jets on Saturday night...
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie QB Jaxson Dart stars in his home preseason debut as the Giants beat the Jets 31-12

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: — For a high school football coach, Teddy Bridgewater can still sling it.
headlines.shortLinkText: Teddy Bridgewater throws 2 TDs as the Buccaneers slip by the Steelers 17-14 in preseason

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — Troy Franklin caught two touchdown passes from Jarrett Stidham and the Denver Broncos rolled over the Arizona Cardinals 27-7 on Saturday night in a matchup of mostly backups.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jarrett Stidham hits Troy Franklin for pair of touchdowns as Broncos roll over Cardinals 27-7

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — Spencer Rattler now has some late-game highlights on his preseason resume as he competes with rookie Tyler Shough to become the New Orleans Saints' starting quarterback.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rattler rallies Saints to 17-all preseason tie with Jaguars as competition with Shough continues

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: — Caleb Williams' rocky training camp now seems to be on the upswing.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caleb Williams looks sharp in Ben Johnson's offense as Bears rout Bills 38-0 in preseason

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at Washington Commanders

headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers beat Panthers 19-10 in preseason finale, but lose 1st-round pick Harmon to sprained knee

events.name: New England Patriots at New York Giants

headlines.shortLinkText: Skattebo plays and Dart clears concussion protocol as Giants beat Patriots in preseason finale

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at New York Jets
Atlanta Falcons at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: — Joe Milton ran for a touchdown and threw for a score to help the Dallas Cowboys beat the Atlanta Falcons 31-13 in the preseason finale for both teams Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joe Milton accounts for 2 TDs as Cowboys beat Falcons 31-13 in preseason finale

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: — Cam Ward's first NFL touchdown of any kind will have to wait for the regular season after the No. 1 overall pick helped the Tennessee Titans wrap up the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Cam Ward's first NFL touchdown will have to wait as Titans beat Vikings 23-13 to wrap preseason

events.name: Chicago Bears at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — Patrick Mahomes and the first-team Kansas City Chiefs offense were in midseason form in their preseason finale Friday night, scoring on each of their three opportunities with the ball before the Chicago Bears rallied for a 29-27 victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes leads sharp Chiefs offense before Bears rally for 29-27 win in preseason finale

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Washington Commanders

headlines.description: — Tyler Loop's final dress rehearsal is over. Baltimore's new kicker looks ready.
headlines.shortLinkText: Loop kicks 61-yard field goal as Ravens finish preseason undefeated with 30-3 win over Commanders

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: — Third-stringer Riley Leonard completed 15 of 20 passes for 189 yards and a touchdown as the Indianapolis Colts beat the Cincinnati Bengals 41-14 on Saturday in the preseason finale for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Third-string QB Riley Leonard shines as Colts beat Bengals 41-14 in preseason finale

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: — Browns coach Kevin Stefanski went with Tyler Huntley instead of Shedeur Sanders when his team had a chance for a winning preseason drive on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Shedeur Sanders struggles, Tyler Huntley leads Browns to last-second 19-17 preseason win over Rams

events.name: Houston Texans at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — The Detroit Lions believe they have found the backup quarterback and depth receiver they were looking for this preseason.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions QB Kyle Allen, rookie WR Isaac TeSlaa solidify roster chances in 26-7 preseason loss to Texans

events.name: Denver Broncos at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — Saints coach Kellen Moore will have to decide soon whether rookie Tyler Shough or second-year pro Spencer Rattler should be New Orleans' starting quarterback in Week 1 of the regular season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints coach Kellen Moore says his QB decision will be 'challenging' after 28-19 loss to the Broncos

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — The Green Bay Packers gave Seattle Seahawks rookie Jalen Milroe some hard lessons about life in the NFL.
headlines.shortLinkText: Malik Willis has TD pass and Packers sack Jalen Milroe 5 times in 20-7 preseason win over Seahawks

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at Miami Dolphins

headlines.shortLinkText: Tua Tagovailoa throws TD pass and is sacked twice as Dolphins beat Jaguars 14-6 to wrap preseason

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — Shane Buechele made the most of his first opportunity to play a full game in the NFL, showing 31 other teams what he can do.
headlines.shortLinkText: With Josh Allen sitting out, Shane Buechele leads Bills to a 23-19 preseason victory over the Bucs

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — Trey Lance's return to the Bay Area led to three straight punts for the Los Angeles Chargers, who went on to lose 30-23 Saturday night to the San Francisco 49ers in the final exhibition game for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: The 49ers spoil Trey Lance's return to the Bay Area with a 30-23 win over the Chargers

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: — It was another short night for Geno Smith, Maxx Crosby and the Las Vegas Raiders starters.
headlines.shortLinkText: Geno Smith throws TD pass in only drive for Raiders, who fall to Cardinals 20-10
